draft_text: This matter arises from a breach of a written Supply Agreement between Meridian Logistics, Inc. and Northgate Packaging Solutions, LLC [E1]. On January 15, 2021, the parties agreed that Northgate would deliver 50,000 corrugated shipping containers per month at a fixed price of $2.40 per unit [E1]. The dispute began in March 2021 when Northgate delivered only 32,000 units, falling 18,000 units short of the contractual minimum [E2]. On April 2, 2021, Meridian sent a written notice of breach demanding cure within thirty days [E2]. Northgate failed to cure, and in May 2021 deliveries fell further to 21,000 units before Northgate suspended all shipments on June 10, 2021, citing a raw-material shortage [E3]. As a direct result, Meridian procured replacement containers on the open market at $3.85 per unit, incurring approximately $1.2 million in cover damages [E4]. Meridian seeks compensatory damages of not less than $1,200,000, pre-judgment interest, and costs of suit [E4].
